I did the extraction for the thing
for them.

I see. Then, again in 1952 -- I guess
they made a whole series in 1952 of those little three minute
shorts, but here's one, "Solitude," and you're playing in the
band; Jimmy Grissom is singing. And another one, at about
the same time, "Sophisticated Lady," three minutes long.

Oh, he did so many things with a lot
of the guys in the band.
